errata.reason: Source-review erratum, 2026-11-13: the FY26 claim that statutory I-GAAP PAT equals IFRS profit within rounding is incorrect for Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited, year ended March 31, 2026. Statutory PAT is INR 13,078 lakh (1,307.8 million); original special-purpose IFRS profit is INR 36,614 lakh (3,661.4 million), a difference of 23,536 lakh (2,353.6 million). The disclosed profit bridge, in INR crore rounded to one decimal, is 130.8 statutory PAT +368.2 insurance contracts (IFRS 17) -2.7 leases (IFRS 16) -14.4 financial instruments (IFRS 9) -18.1 share-based payments (IFRS 2) +4.8 employee benefits (IAS 19) -102.5 income taxes (IAS 12) =366.1 IFRS profit; adjustments total +235.3 crore. At the finer endpoint precision, 130.78+235.30=366.08 versus 366.14 crore: retain an unassigned +0.06 crore (+6 lakh/+0.6 million) precision residual. Exact lakh allocations of the rounded components remain unverified. The IAS 12 bridge adjustment is not total IFRS tax expense, which is 3,046+6,805=9,851 lakh. Statutory basic/diluted EPS is INR 0.71; original IFRS basic/diluted EPS is INR 1.99/1.98. Numerical matches do not verify Capital IQ normalized/reported EPS definitions or any forward consensus accounting basis. These are statutory I-GAAP versus audited, management-purpose special-purpose IFRS statements; Ind AS is not assumed equivalent to IFRS. This retrospective annotation does not establish first public availability before June 22, 2026, rerun the analysis, replace frozen prose or numbers, change forecasts or scenario assumptions/levels, or create or revise a valuation, rating or investment decision.

errata.reason: Source-review erratum, 2026-11-13: the clean-surplus equation in the legacy RI model is a forecast assumption, not the observed FY26 book roll-forward for Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited. In the original audited special-purpose IFRS statements, year ended March 31, 2026, all following amounts are INR lakh: financial-asset fair-value OCI is -15,762+3,967 tax=-11,795; defined-benefit OCI is -482+121 tax=-361; total OCI is -11,795-361=-12,156. Profit of 36,614 plus OCI of -12,156 gives total comprehensive income of 24,458. OCI stays outside PAT. The full relevant statement-of-changes-in-equity build is opening equity 329,237 + profit 36,614 + shares issued 2,507 - share-issue transaction costs 98 + employee stock-compensation expense 2,392 + share-application money additions 2,255 - share-application money utilisation 2,507 - defined-benefit OCI 361 - financial-asset OCI 11,795 = closing equity 358,244, with zero residual at disclosed lakh precision. Employee stock compensation is noncash; these movements are not all cash capital inflows. Internal ESOP-allotment transfers of -1,223 reserve/+1,223 premium and lapsed-option transfers of -146 reserve/+146 retained earnings cancel in total equity. This observed IFRS roll-forward neither adds OCI to PAT nor forecasts future OCI, recurring conversion adjustments, future ROE/ROTE or future capital movements. It records a qualification on the original model and downstream reliance; it does not recalculate or replace any frozen forecast, scenario or fair-value level, or create an investment call.
